about: Citation ledger. Every 'evidence' id used anywhere in the repo resolves here. Citations are 'path:line[-line]' relative to the project root that contains design-repo/ (src/, tailwind.config.js, index.html, ia/, docs/). When that sibling tree is absent (standalone copy), verify_all.py checks ranges against fileLineCounts and WARNS instead of reading the files. QA references point at a session scratchpad outside the project and are descriptive only; their measured numbers are copied here in 'value'/'raw'.
excludedSourcesNote: A user-saved copy of the live site sits next to the project. It is excluded entirely: never cited, copied or packaged.
